simple.meaning: a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זַלְעָפָה (H2152) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: זַלְעָפָה (zalʻâphâh) means a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming) First listed occurrence: Lam 5 10.

definitions.short: a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming)
definitions.full: H2152. zalaphah זַלְעָפָה noun feminine raging heat (on formation compare Ges Lbg 863 Ol § 196 a. 1. 2 ) — ׳ז Psa 119:53 ; plural absolute זִלְעָפוֺת 11:6 ; construct זִלְעֲפוֺת Lam 5:10 ; — 1 of fever heat of famine ׳ז רָעָב Lam 5:10 . 2 of burning wind ז ׳רוּח Psa 11:6 (in figurative of ׳י s judgment, with גָּפְרִית אֵשׁ, ). 3 figurative of zeal ׳ז אֲחָזַתְנִי Psa 119:53 .
definitions.rootNote: or זִלְעָפָה xlit zilʻâphâph corrected to zilʻâphâh ; from 2196 ;
